Zangarra is a secluded cove off the Tanaan Channel, between Talador and Tanaan Jungle. The cove serves as the base of operations of the Kirin Tor in and has several wards and arcane elementals standing guard. There is a transporter from the top of the cliff down to Khadgar's Tower. Despite the Kirin Tor being officially affiliated with the Alliance, the pragmatic Archmage Khadgar accepts help from both the Alliance and Horde. Thus both sides can use the services provided by the NPCs. In the lower parts of the area, there are many plant and marsh creatures including sporebats, podlings and spore giants.

The Zangar sea, and thus the Zangar encroachment, was created from the rotting body of the Sporemound Zang. One strain of fungus in particular is especially prevalent in Draenor's fungal ecosystem, causing Dr. Hadley Ricard to name it Zangarium Draenormycota. from Warcraft III]] Zerging in WoW is a term that now means attacking an enemy (or a group of enemies) with a far bigger group of weaker units (or, alternatively, to keep resurrecting and running back to the fight, creating the illusion of an endless number of units). The word is derived from the Zergling rush (sometimes shortened to Zerg rush) strategy in StarCraft. Zerg is also the name of the race in Starcraft. For example, "Could you remember to spread aggro, because the priest keeps getting zerged when he heals you?" Zero-sum DKP means that DKP is distributed based on the value of items that drop. All members in a zero-sum DKP start with a score of 0. When an item is given to a raid member, they have to pay for it in DKP (going negative if necessary). These DKP spent are immediately distributed among all the raid members. Thus the amount of DKP, i.e. the sum of all members in the system, is always zero. The idea here is that inflation is impossible, since no points enter the system from the outside. Zengu tasks Horde adventurers with collecting the scattered pieces of the :Sigil of Ignaeus before retrieving Trol'kalar from Trollbane's Tomb in Stromgarde. After obtaining Trol'kalar, Zengu tried to leave Arathi by himself, but the forces of Stromgarde simply killed him and reclaimed the sword.

Zerid is an ethereal quest giver located at Aeris Landing in Nagrand. He is the head of security at the encampment, and is concerned about the proximity of Aeris Landing to Oshu'gun because of the voidspawn and rogue ethereals in the area. He orders the death of the rogue ethereal's leader, Gava'xi. Additionally, he will reward those who kill voidspawn around Oshu'gun.
Zephyrion is an ethereal quest giver located at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm. He is interested in excavating the Ruins of Farahlon for its artifacts.

__NOTOC__ Zesty Clam Meat can be found inside a Big-Mouth Clam, dropped by murlocs, found in the Swamp of Sorrows, and level ~40 naga. The east coast of the Swamp of Sorrows has many sea creatures that drop these clams, including the aforementioned murlocs, along with crabs, and naga.
Zhevra Hooves drop from Zhevra Runners in the Northern Barrens.
__NOTOC__ The Zeppelin Debris are located throughout southern Hellfire Peninsula.
Zeb'Sora Troll Ears drop from Shadowpine Rippers and Shadowpine Witches in the Ghostlands.

Weaved entirely of metallic threads, the cloak was marked with runes similar to those from the Disks of Uldaman. Despite repeated requests from the high councils of Khaz Modan and Bael Modan, Zecker never presented himself or the cloak for inspection. Now, the dwarves know why. When the cloak was closely examined after his disappearance, it was discovered that its properties were the result of ingenious construction rather than the blessings of the titans. Zeppelin Cargo is originally found east of Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh. It is later provided as an objective for Delivery for Drazzit.
Zelemar the Wrathful is a doomguard in Ragefire Chasm. Paladins on the quest The Path of the Adept can summon him by interacting with an orb of demon blood.
== In Warcraft III == Zenedar is one of the random hero names for the Dreadlords in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos.
The Zezzak's Shard is provided as an objective for The Eyes of Grillok.
Zeppit's Crystal is provided as an objective for Bloody Imp-ossible!.
Zelfan is one of the 8 different NPCs that can be with Priestess Delrissa, the third boss in Magisters' Terrace. He is a gan'arg engineer. He is crowd-controllable, but immune to enslave demon.

:Were you looking for Zhevra, the Barrens creature that resembles a zebra? A term first said by Kaethan on the Frostmane(US) realm. Instead of describing a Alterac Valley battleground as a "Turtle" in which the Horde camp Frostwolf Keep's ramp in the tower to the Frostwolf Relief Hut. He described it as a "Zebra" because of the Alliance running into death at the ramp fastly killing off all their reinforcements and the chance to win. Zeerox is a famed arcanist known for creating the copy slate spell. The spell allowed writing or drawings to be copied onto fresh parchment or similar medium, leaving the original unaltered.
Zeh'gehn is a jungle troll located at Scalawag Point in the Howling Fjord.
Zelig the Visionary is a human seer located at the Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight.
Zelig's Scrying Orb is provided as an objective for Frostmourne Cavern (quest).
Zepik the Gorloc Hunter is a wolvar quest giver summoned by Zepik's Hunting Horn. He is also kept captive by the lich Artruis the Heartless inside the cave of The Sundered Shard.

Zeb'Halak is a village located south of Drak'Tharon Keep in the Grizzly Hills. It is a bunch of little troll huts surrounding a ziggurat that's topped by a massive stone head called the Seer of Zeb'Halak. Prior to the war against the Lich King, the village fell to the Scourge before the Alliance ever arrived in Northrend; all the Drakkari were slaughtered. Following the war against the Jailer, the village was visited by the brothers Bronzebeard, who later reported that the village is now just a ruin infested with aimless ghouls.

Zend'li Venomtusk is a jungle troll poisons vendor located at Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
__NOTOC__ Zebu'tan is a jungle troll poison vendor located at Agmar's Hammer in Dragonblight. He has a huge crush on Alys Vol'tyr, giving her roses, despite her constant rebuffs.
Zelli Hotnozzle is a goblin zeppelin master located in Orgrimmar. She gives information about The Zephyr.
Zeev Fizzlespark is a goblin being held prisoner by the frost vrykul in Brunnhildar Village located in Storm Peaks. He is a brother of Gretchen Fizzlespark.
Zhaagrym, possibly a pun on Zarhym, is the pet of the warlock Serissa Grimdabbler (Horde side) or Harkzog (Alliance side) in the Trial of the Crusader raid.
Zen'Kiki (or Zen'kiki) is a jungle troll druid of the Cenarion Circle.

Zen'tabra (also spelled Zen'Tabra) is a jungle troll druid trainer on Darkspear Isle. Zen'tabra later appears during the Firelands Invasion patrolling The Regrowth in Mount Hyjal alongside Celestine of the Harvest, Mardant Strongoak and Gart Mistrunner.

Zen'Taji is a jungle troll quest giver found in Southfury Watershed. His tasks are part of Thonk's assignment to help the survivors of the flooding that occurred with the Cataclysm. He is a druid studying the affects of the flooding of the Southfury River after the Cataclysm.

Zerit was, along with Nuzo, one of two bankers located in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar. Several customers stood in line at each station. He and Nuzo are not present after the Goblin Slums became the Orgrimmar Embassy.

Zeke Bootscuff is a goblin quest giver found at Bootlegger Outpost in central Tanaris. He spent a week staring at the silithid pit trying to think of how to fulfill Marin's mission, but he ran out of ideas and was starving. Zen'Taji's Cloak is a quest reward from That's the End of That Raptor.

Zen'Vorka is a jungle troll found inside the Sentinel Tree of Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front. Zen'Vorka will become unlocked once the player completes the initial assault on the front, some of his wares include commendation writs for racial cities.

Zen'Vorka's Cache is sold by Zen'Vorka inside the Sentinel Tree on the Molten Front for . It provides players with a sink for their excess Mark of the World Tree. It contains a random green item, and has small chance (~5%) to contain a Scorched Stone companion.
__NOTOC__ Zeya is a jungle troll quest giver found just inside Blackfathom Deeps.
